notes.title: Are you ready to start your journey?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33284119/c4269e543befaf87d1ca321c00b8db13a5b92f91.jpg[/img]
You are the faceless hero, who has to fulfil his destiny. Your path lead you to the Underworld, where you will face evil and lost spirits, your duty is to save them! 
Will you be able to open all the secrets and save the world? What is waiting for you? 
Red and The Deadly Sins will bring you joy with a unique design, beautiful soundtrack and extraordinary story! 

The journey awaits!
